Pursuant your request, I have reviewed the status of the playfield located west of Sunnyside and east of Franklin Avenues. The following has been determined:
(1) The playfield is a grassed area and not used for formal recreation.
(2) No plans for converting the playfield to a formal recreation area are being presently made or in the foreseeable future.
(3) The use of the playfield is not significant to the recreational needs of the community.
If you have any further questions on this matter, prease contact me as soon as possible.
Yours truly,
Charles N. Rellis
